search_serpstack: search serpstack.com API with a query and return filtered SearchResult objects
search_serpstack_https: search serpstack.com using HTTPS and return top 10 organic results as SearchResult objects
search_serpstack_filtered: search serpstack.com and filter results by a list of allowed domains
search_serpstack_http: search serpstack.com using HTTP instead of HTTPS for the API request
search_serpstack_count: search serpstack.com and limit results to a specified count
